notes: Replication statistics are author-reported primary post-completion registration values for the supplied OSF locator, not the pooled Collabra meta-analysis. The authors give an overall failure verdict; no separate likability replication-success verdict is supplied in this registration. Original sample is stated as 33, but the printed t(32) is retained without correction. Original likability effect size and test statistic are not printed. Replication p and t are from the corresponding equal-variances-assumed SPSS test; d is the author-reported post-completion registration effect for the same outcome. The replication analytic n is printed per group, without conversion to a new statistic.
